- SH-1014 (shp_0014)
- SH-1022 (shp_0022)
- SH-1051 (shp_0051)
- SH-1077 (shp_0077)
- SH-1102 (shp_0102)

Each reassignment returned HTTP 200 with carrier_id car_0005 (DPD) and status still created. A follow-up query for created PostNL shipments (carrier car_0002) returned an empty list.

I did not touch PostNL shipments in any other status (in transit, delayed, delivered or returned). The carrier list showed DPD as active, so no reassignment was blocked.
